objective: Increase profitable cross-regime intelligence by letting Gen3C temporal memories gain or lose influence only from genuinely realized, causally available outcomes of their own recent proposals while preserving opportunity coverage.

frozen_configuration.reliability_update_rule: Outcome can change memory utility only after the chosen action horizon has completed.
frozen_configuration.equal_weight_anchor: 55% fixed equal-memory weight plus 45% causal reliability softmax.

failed_generation_experience_used.GEN3D: Learned meta-gating overfit and made all four frozen folds negative; Gen3G therefore has no separate meta model selecting a memory.
failed_generation_experience_used.GEN3E: Trade-quality filtering collapsed to more than 99.9% WAIT; Gen3G therefore preserves Gen3C opportunity coverage and never converts reliability into a hard WAIT gate.
failed_generation_experience_used.GEN3F_V2: Funding/OI improved the worst average loss but damaged median performance and worst drawdown; Gen3G therefore does not add leverage-state features to this frozen experiment.

parallel_data_research.purpose: Data availability only across 24 spot markets and 8 dates spanning F1-F4.
